description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a data model using Pydantic and an endpoint for updating an item. It includes class definitions, route handler functions, and makes use of annotations for request body validation with example data.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic data model representing an item with attributes 'name', 'description', 'price', and 'tax'.
